title: Issue #4191 Linux GTK dependency install reliability
intent: Settling the execution record after PR #4203 merged
summary: PR #4203 merged. Work ledger pushed and the derived matrix is PASS (vrr-245b3df25b2f4dcaaf252272a2e114d1); finishing the execution settlement.
progress_summary: Direct-mode fix for #4191, delivered. Measured the step over 60 green runs (p50 29s, p95 60s, max 106s) and concluded a cap raise alone could not fix a stalled mirror, so the deadline moved into scripts/ci-apt.sh: 900s total budget, 3 attempts x 240s with 15s backoff, a gtk-deps mode owning the package set, an apt archive cache, and a job-summary marker separating a dependency-install failure from a test failure. The five workflow step caps became an 18-minute outer net, and a contract test derives the required cap from the script's own default. RED observed, then GREEN. Verified the cfg(unix) half and the full derived matrix in a Linux container after closing four container-vs-runner parity gaps; AC-2 proven against real apt (cold 211 MB / 164s, warm Need to get 0 B / 67s) and again on a real runner (cache hit, 0 B, 19s step). All 19 CI checks green; PR #4203 went Ready and is now merged.
